title: SDLC Task Delivery v1
description: The task-specific payload for packaging, releasing, linking, installing, integrating, or performing another bounded delivery action. Intent declares the authoritative inputs, delivery kind, artifacts, procedures, and non-goals. Result records delivery status, produced artifacts, executions, and limitations without mutating the parent task or work-item lifecycle.
$comment: The common https://schemas.handschuh.dev/sdlc/task-envelope/v1 owns task identity, processing state, routing, dependencies, repository context, and the common task wrapper. This payload intentionally has exactly two high-level properties: intent and result. Host validation must resolve input refs, artifact refs, procedure refs, and execution procedure refs; verify required inputs and artifacts; ensure required procedures have executions; verify that artifact digests match the selected repository revision or captured artifact bytes; and keep approval, deployment authorization, and parent lifecycle mutation outside this payload. The delivery result status is not the task or work-item status: a delivered result may make complete eligible under policy but does not itself perform that transition.

DeliveryResult.description: The actual delivery result. Its status summarizes delivery work and is independent of the parent task or work-item lifecycle status.
